name: second-opinion
description: Second Opinion: Agent Skills for using AI with open eyes. code-teardown gives an evidence-backed verdict on code you did not write; ai-evidence scores the evidence that an image, a text or a codebase was made or edited with AI; architecture-mentor teaches you to decide stack, architecture and hosting before building.

plugins.name: code-teardown
plugins.description: Critical, evidence-backed teardown of source repos, .pyc files and Docker images.

plugins.name: ai-evidence
plugins.description: Weighs the evidence that an image, a text or a codebase was generated or edited with AI and reports scored evidence, not a verdict.

plugins.name: architecture-mentor
plugins.description: Teaches you to decide architecture, infrastructure and stack before building, and explains an existing project and why it is built that way.
